flags.detail: Participation Requirements 2(b) (PF-04) allow a site to show prices and availability only when Amazon serves the link or through the Product Advertising API, and 6(t) (PF-05) bars displaying customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through the API or a qualifying link. The prices and ratings on this site are dated observations (2026-11-14, S46-S48) kept for analysis, with a date stamp adjacent per PF-27. Before this site is used commercially, remove these values or re-source them via Special Links or the Creators API. Prices are also volatile deal prices (Z-F5 in COORDINATION.md). [Kept from PR #26 (session 9fef7647), renumbered from FLG-023 by session b90c5685: on main that ID already names a different finding. Both findings are kept.]
flags.action: Remove or re-source observed prices/ratings via API or Special Links before commercial use.

flags.item: Earlier builds disagreed on whether the links resolve; re-verification 2026-11-14 settles the factual part
flags.detail: The root build (sessions 7f84fea4/33226b37) recorded that the submitted identifiers select no product page; the /docs/ build (session 79f85104, Z-F6) recorded that all three short links resolve to real listings, with control evidence Z-V10 to Z-V14. Session 9fef7647 re-fetched all three links on 2026-11-14 and reproduced the /docs/ result exactly (S52-S54). Both earlier statements are true of different things: the codes are not ASINs (they select nothing at amazon.com/dp/), and the links resolve stably to three listings. This site now states both. flags.item: PR #26 filled product name/brand/price/rating from the redirect destinations; this integration keeps those cells blank
flags.detail: Session 9fef7647 (PR #26, branch arena/9fef7647-zone3) treated each short link's destination as the submitted product and filled product_name, brand, price, rating and review_count, and built a marketing page that quotes those prices and ratings as 'as listed' facts. Session b90c5685 re-fetched all three links on 2026-11-14 and reproduced the destinations exactly (S55), but no official source read states which product the owner intended, and the submitted codes are 9 characters, not ASINs (S06, S08-S10, FLG-001). A destination value is therefore an observation about a different page, not a verified attribute of the submitted link (FLG-002, FLG-028). It is also a display-policy issue: prices and star ratings may not be shown without an Amazon-served link or API data (PF-04, PF-05; FLG-022, FLG-029). PR #26's readings are preserved verbatim in data/products.json under observed_2026_11_14 and value_sources_2026_11_14; they are not rendered as product facts.
